'''Droid Security Systems (DSS)''' was a division of [[Sacul Industries Group]]. The company provided [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] used by a number of travel agencies, including the improved [[IM series]] and [[G2 repair droid/Legends|G2 repair droids]].<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This organization was mentioned only in an advertisement on the video screen found exclusively in the queue of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' at [[Tokyo Disneyland]].<ref name="ST2" /> Since the G2-series droids advertised are already established as products of other companies, DSS likely only provided these droids to companies. The IM-series droids, however, were most likely created by them.
